integrity: The proof is theoretical. Exact finite-field checks are limited and independent review has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Reduced component intersections only; scheme-theoretic multiplicities and singularity classification not claimed. General proof for the restricted Witt algebra of prime characteristic greater than three, with finite-field examples as checks. Full text of the 2015 higher-tuple comparator inaccessible; literature priority not certified.
title: The interval intersection lattice of the nilpotent Witt commuting variety
